findings.summary: Dev-note input_commit still does not match this attempt's dispatch input_commit. Spec §5 item 4 requires the dev-note input_commit to be the dispatch's input_commit (9906c85c2c887741c58a3980b27988f5b3f70be9 for this rework attempt), but docs/dev-notes/dev_ledr_g5_triage_read_01.md:4 records f01f31ac353f0099c7fbfada9a4a3158855417ff. The prior review flagged the same field with a different wrong value; the Implementer corrected it but to yet another non-matching hash. This breaks the audit trail identity discipline but does not affect the product code correctness.
